_about: Reviewed choice of the sense that leads a lexeme's one-line gloss in the index (scripts/ar-build-index.mts): for a listed "<vocalized head>|<POS>" the gloss is the first source sense (over all entries of that head and part of speech) whose gloss holds one of the keywords as a whole word; the gloss TEXT stays the source's. Seeded from the curated beginner list of scripts/alphabet-sprint/ar.mts (keywords confirmed against the extract) and the lead's additions. The dictionary's sense list is not changed.
